name: Garrys Mod
author: support@pterodactyl.io
description: Garrys Mod 是一款由 Garry Newman 打造、其公司 Facepunch Studios 開發的沙盒物理遊戲。

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd 基礎安裝腳本
#
# 伺服器檔案：/mnt/server

## 以防有人移除了預設值。
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "尚未設定 steam 使用者。\n"
    echo -e "正在使用匿名使用者。\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "使用者已設定為 ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## 下載並安裝 steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # 若此資料夾不存在，修正 steamcmd 磁碟寫入錯誤
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# 若不這麼做，即使以 root 執行 SteamCMD 也會因故失敗。
# 反正這在安裝流程結束時也會被變更。
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## 使用 steamcmd 安裝遊戲
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit ## 視安裝情況可能需要其他旗標。（說的就是你，cs 1.6）

## 設定 32 位元函式庫
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## 設定 64 位元函式庫
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# 建立遊戲所需的預設檔案
cd /mnt/server/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server
echo '
-- Docs: https://wiki.garrysmod.com/page/resource/AddWorkshop
-- Place the ID of the workshop addon you want to be downloaded to people who join your server, not the collection ID
-- Use https://beta.configcreator.com/create/gmod/resources.lua to easily create a list based on your collection ID

resource.AddWorkshop( "" )
' > workshop.lua

cd /mnt/server/garrysmod/cfg
echo '
// Please do not set RCon in here, use the startup parameters.

hostname		"New Gmod Server"
sv_password		""
sv_loadingurl   ""
sv_downloadurl  ""

// Steam Server List Settings
// sv_location "eu"
sv_region "255"
sv_lan "0"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

// Server Limits
sbox_maxprops		100
sbox_maxragdolls	5
sbox_maxnpcs		10
sbox_maxballoons	10
sbox_maxeffects		10
sbox_maxdynamite	10
sbox_maxlamps		10
sbox_maxthrusters	10
sbox_maxwheels		10
sbox_maxhoverballs	10
sbox_maxvehicles	20
sbox_maxbuttons		10
sbox_maxsents		20
sbox_maxemitters	5
sbox_godmode		0
sbox_noclip		    0

// Network Settings - Please keep these set to default.

sv_minrate		75000
sv_maxrate		0
gmod_physiterations	2
net_splitpacket_maxrate	45000
decalfrequency		12 

// Execute Ban Files - Please do not edit
exec banned_ip.cfg 
exec banned_user.cfg 

// Add custom lines under here
' > server.cfg

variables.name: Steam Account Token

variables.description: 伺服器重新啟動時更新遊戲所需，請勿修改此項。

variables.name: Workshop ID
variables.description: 你的創意工坊收藏（workshop collection）ID（網址結尾的數字）

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: 你的遊戲伺服器允許的最大玩家人數。

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: Tickrate 決定伺服器更新每個實體位置的速度。

variables.description:
0 = 停用 Lua 重新整理，
1 = 啟用 Lua 重新整理
